% The space around blocks, as in the PDF of a 12pt article: \intextsep
% around floats and \floatsep between two, the caption skips of the
% kernel's \@makecaption, \topsep around center, flushleft, flushright,
% and verbatim, and the display skips around display math, a picture in
% display math, and an \intertext. A center or verbatim after
% a paragraph with a footnote has the same space as after a paragraph.
\documentclass[12pt]{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,graphicx,tikz-cd}
\begin{document}
A paragraph before the floats.

\begin{figure}[h]
    \centering
    \includegraphics{test-picture.png}
    \caption{A picture, with its caption below.}
\end{figure}
\begin{table}[h]
    \centering
    \caption{A table, with its caption above.}
    \begin{tabular}{cc}
        a & b \\
        c & d
    \end{tabular}
\end{table}

A paragraph after the floats.
\begin{center}
    Centered.
\end{center}
A paragraph after a center.
\begin{flushleft}
    At the left.
\end{flushleft}
A paragraph after a flushleft.
\begin{flushright}
    At the right.
\end{flushright}
A paragraph after a flushright.
\begin{verbatim}
verbatim text
\end{verbatim}
A paragraph after a verbatim.
\begin{center}
    One center.
\end{center}
\begin{center}
    Another center.
\end{center}
A paragraph after two centers.
\[ x^2 + y^2 = z^2 \]
A paragraph after a display.
\begin{align}
    a &= b + c \\
\intertext{and some text between the rows}
    d &= e + f
\end{align}
A paragraph after an alignment.
\[ \begin{tikzcd} A \arrow[r] & B \end{tikzcd} \]
A paragraph after a diagram.

A paragraph with a footnote.\footnote{A footnote.}
\begin{center}
    Centered after a footnote.
\end{center}
A paragraph with another footnote.\footnote{Another footnote.}
\begin{verbatim}
verbatim after a footnote
\end{verbatim}
\end{document}
